d: Sarkari skulon men bachchon ko parhane ki zimmedari shikshakon ki hoti hai, lekin janganna, chunav, SIR, sarve aur dusre prashasnik kamon men unki dyuti lagae jane se parhaee prabhavit ho rahi hai. jabki shiksha ka adhikar (RTE) kanun shikshakon se karae jane vale gair-shaikshanik kamon ko simit karta hai. iske bavjud deshbhar ke sarkari skulon men yah samasya bani huee hai. niti aayog ki 2026 ki riport se lekar shikshakon ke anubhvon aur rajnitik bahson tak, is riport men samjhie ki sarkari skulon ke shikshak parhane ke bajay dusre kamon men kyon uljhe hain, iska bachchon ki parhaee par…
